briefs.brief_cn: PLPC 的核心假设是：它不是建设输电线路的 EPC，也不是公用事业公司，而是输电线路每个塔位都可能用到的线夹、预绞式金具、导线附件、绝缘子串硬件、变电站连接件等硬件供应商。如果 AI 数据中心、制造业大负荷接入、可再生能源并网和电网加固推动输电建设，硬件采购可能早于 EPC 施工收入 6-12 个月反映在订单中。市场可能忽略它，是因为筛选电网受益标的时通常先看到 Quanta、MYR、Hubbell、变压器厂商或公用事业，而 PLPC 被归为小型工业件公司。下一步必须用公司年报、10-K、电话会、产品目录和客户认证资料验证：输电相关产品收入占比、订单/积压节奏、客户批准清单、竞争格局，以及机器人或标准化安装是否提高切换成本。
briefs.brief_en: PLPC’s chokepoint hypothesis is that it sits upstream of visible grid EPC revenue: it supplies transmission-line fittings, formed-wire products, conductor accessories, string hardware, and related utility hardware that must be specified, approved, procured, and delivered before crews build or upgrade lines. If AI load growth, large-load interconnection, renewables, and grid-hardening drive transmission buildout, PLPC order intake could lead downstream EPC revenue. The market may miss it because investors usually screen for utilities, EPCs, transformer OEMs, or diversified grid-equipment names, while PLPC appears as a small industrial hardware company. The evidence path is concrete: confirm product-level transmission exposure, backlog/order cadence, utility-approved-vendor status, customer concentration, and whether standardized or robotic installation raises switching costs.
briefs.chokepoint_thesis: PLPC may be a scarce, public pure-play supplier of transmission-line hardware that is required before line construction, making its orders a potential early-cycle signal for grid expansion.
evidence_to_verify: Primary company filings: latest 10-K/10-Q revenue discussion, product categories, geographic and end-market disclosures.
Backlog or order-intake commentary in earnings releases and conference calls, especially any acceleration before EPC backlog recognition.
Product catalog and technical documentation showing transmission-line hardware, formed-wire products, conductor accessories, substation fittings, and utility applications.
Customer or utility-approved-vendor evidence, including specifications, procurement documents, or utility material standards naming PLPC products.
Competitive mapping against MacLean Power Systems, Hubbell Power Systems, and private or regional hardware suppliers.
Evidence of robotic installation, installation tooling, or standardized installation practices that could increase switching costs.
falsification: Transmission-specific products are immaterial to revenue or mostly distribution/communications rather than high-voltage grid buildout.
Orders do not lead EPC activity and instead track normal replacement demand with no visible backlog inflection.
Utility approvals are broad and commoditized, with many qualified substitute suppliers and limited pricing power.
Margins decline despite grid demand, implying the hardware is not a true chokepoint.
Revenue growth is driven by unrelated product lines or acquisitions rather than transmission hardware.
briefs.hidden_signal_to_verify: Whether transmission-specific fittings, string hardware, conductor accessories, substation fittings, and utility-approved designs are a material portion of revenue; whether order intake leads downstream EPC revenue by 6-12 months; whether robotic or standardized installation raises switching costs.
monitoring_items: Quarterly order intake, backlog, book-to-bill, and lead-time commentary.
Gross margin and operating margin resilience during rising utility capex.
New utility approvals, customer wins, or product-standard references.
Transmission capex plans from major utilities, PJM/SPP interconnection reforms, and large-load interconnection rule developments.
EPC backlog trends at Quanta, MYR Group, and other grid contractors as downstream confirmation.
briefs.why_underfollowed: It is not categorized as a utility, EPC contractor, transformer manufacturer, or large electrical-equipment company. Its products are small-ticket but mission-critical bill-of-material components, so the market may overlook them when focusing on headline grid capex, AI power demand, and large EPC backlogs.

briefs.brief_cn: Hammond Power Solutions 的假设是：干式变压器、电能质量产品和磁性器件可能成为数据中心、工业电气化、可再生能源并网、微电网和半导体项目中的交付瓶颈。它比大型综合电气设备公司更纯，但目前关键缺口是不能确认数据中心或高增长电网升级占比有多高。市场可能低估它，是因为干式变压器看起来像传统工业品，而不是 AI 电力基础设施的时间表关键件。下一步应核验终端市场收入拆分、积压订单、交付周期、产能扩张、价格传导、毛利率可持续性，以及需求是否来自真实供应短缺而非短周期补库存。
briefs.brief_en: Hammond Power Solutions is a plausible power-infrastructure chokepoint because dry-type transformers, power-quality equipment, and magnetics are schedule-critical components for data centers, industrial electrification, renewables, microgrids, utilities, and semiconductor projects. The unresolved issue is purity: the direct contribution from hyperscale data centers and grid upgrades must be proven rather than assumed. The market may miss the angle because dry-type transformers are often viewed as mature industrial products, not as electrical-infrastructure constraints for AI load growth. The evidence path should focus on end-market mix, backlog, lead times, capacity additions, pricing, and whether margins reflect genuine scarcity.
briefs.chokepoint_thesis: HPS.A may benefit from persistent electrical-distribution bottlenecks if dry-type transformers and power-quality products remain supply-constrained across data centers, industrial electrification, and grid upgrades.
evidence_to_verify: Latest annual and quarterly reports disclosing revenue by geography, product category, and end market.
Management commentary on data centers, utilities, renewables, industrial automation, semiconductors, and electrification demand.
Backlog, book-to-bill, lead-time, and capacity-utilization disclosures.
Capital-expenditure and capacity-expansion announcements.
Gross margin and pricing commentary to distinguish structural scarcity from temporary inflation or mix effects.
Customer concentration or distributor-channel evidence showing exposure to large electrical infrastructure projects.
falsification: Data-center, utility, and grid-upgrade exposure is small or not growing materially.
Backlog normalizes quickly and lead times compress, indicating no durable bottleneck.
Margins revert as capacity enters the market or copper/steel costs pressure pricing.
Revenue growth is mostly cyclical industrial demand rather than structural electrification.
Large OEMs or low-cost competitors erode share in dry-type transformers and power-quality products.
briefs.hidden_signal_to_verify: Segment exposure to data centers, utility upgrades, renewable interconnection, industrial automation, lead times, backlog conversion, margin resilience, and any capacity additions.
monitoring_items: Quarterly backlog, order growth, and book-to-bill.
Lead-time commentary for dry-type transformers and power-quality systems.
Capacity additions and utilization rates.
End-market disclosures for data centers, utilities, renewables, and industrial electrification.
Margin durability versus input-cost movements.
briefs.why_underfollowed: Transformer and power-quality products can be screened as ordinary industrial components. Investors focused on AI power may favor utilities, power producers, switchgear, or large-cap electrical OEMs, missing a mid-cap supplier with potentially purer exposure to electrical distribution constraints.

briefs.brief_cn: KSH International 是本组中证据最弱但潜在卡点最强的候选：假设它生产连续换位导线 CTC、纸包铜导线 PICC 或 HVDC 变压器相关输入材料，处在变压器 OEM 上游。如果高压直流、可再生能源外送和大型变压器需求上升，而 OEM 认证、PGCIL 或其他电网审批、客户审厂和产能爬坡形成门槛，则上游导线材料可能成为被忽视的瓶颈。但当前必须先确认最基础事实：上市状态、准确 ticker、财务数据、产品收入占比、客户与审批资质。若这些无法验证，应降级为 speculative shadow。
briefs.brief_en: KSH International is the weakest-evidence but potentially highest-bottleneck candidate in this chunk. The hypothesis is that it supplies upstream transformer inputs such as continuously transposed conductors, paper-insulated copper conductors, or HVDC transformer-related conductors. If HVDC, renewables transmission, and large power transformers are structurally constrained, qualified conductor suppliers could become scarce because transformer OEM approvals, grid-authority qualifications, customer audits, and process know-how create barriers. However, the first task is basic verification: listing status, correct ticker, financials, product mix, approval status, customer base, and capacity expansion. Until verified, this should remain a speculative shadow candidate despite being ranked in the chunk.
briefs.chokepoint_thesis: KSH may sit one layer upstream of transformer OEMs in specialized conductors used for large transformers and HVDC equipment, where qualification and process reliability could create supplier scarcity.
evidence_to_verify: Official exchange listing page and correct ticker/security identifier.
Audited annual reports and latest financial statements.
Revenue mix for CTC, PICC, magnet wire, transformer conductors, or related products.
Approvals or qualifications from PGCIL, transformer OEMs, utilities, or HVDC project customers.
Customer list, customer concentration, and audit/qualification-cycle evidence.
Capacity expansion filings, environmental approvals, plant-level disclosures, or capex announcements.
Copper pass-through or pricing-contract mechanics to assess margin exposure.
falsification: Company is not publicly listed or ticker cannot be verified.
CTC/PICC/HVDC-related products are immaterial or not disclosed.
No credible evidence of transformer OEM qualification or grid-authority approval.
Revenue depends mostly on commodity copper processing with limited differentiation.
Copper price volatility overwhelms margins and there is no pass-through protection.
Capacity expansion is delayed, unfunded, or not tied to qualified customer demand.
briefs.hidden_signal_to_verify: Confirm public listing status and ticker format, PGCIL approval status, share of revenue from CTC/PICC, HVDC order pipeline, customer concentration with transformer OEMs, copper pass-through mechanics, and capacity expansion.
monitoring_items: Listing and primary disclosure verification.
FY revenue mix and segment/product disclosures.
PGCIL, utility, or transformer-OEM approval updates.
HVDC, renewable-transmission, and large-transformer order pipeline.
Capacity expansion execution and working-capital strain.
Gross margin sensitivity to copper prices.
briefs.why_underfollowed: If the thesis is valid, the company is hidden two steps away from the obvious demand driver: investors screen for grid projects, transformer OEMs, utilities, or EPCs, not conductor inputs embedded inside transformer bills of material. It may also be missed because listing status, ticker format, and public disclosures are not straightforward.

briefs.brief_cn: Arcosa 的电网假设来自其工程结构件/公用事业结构业务：输电、配电和变电站可能需要钢杆、结构件和相关基础设施。它的纯度低于 PLPC 或 HPS.A，因为公司还有建筑产品、交通和其他基础设施敞口。市场可能忽略它，是因为 ACA 常被归类为多元化基建或建材公司，而不是电网瓶颈公司。关键验证点是公用事业结构的订单、积压、交付周期、产能、价格和利润率是否显示真实短缺，而不是普通基建周期。
briefs.brief_en: Arcosa’s grid thesis rests on engineered utility structures used in transmission, distribution, and substations. It is less pure than PLPC or HPS.A because Arcosa also has broader infrastructure and construction-products exposure. The underfollowed angle is classification: the company may screen as diversified infrastructure rather than as a grid-hardening or transmission-buildout supplier. The evidence path should isolate utility-structures backlog, lead times, capacity, pricing, margins, and customer mix to determine whether this is a true bottleneck or just a cyclical infrastructure segment.
briefs.chokepoint_thesis: Arcosa may have hidden leverage to transmission, distribution, substation, and grid-hardening capex through engineered utility structures, if segment backlog and margins show supply scarcity.
evidence_to_verify: Segment-level filings and investor presentations isolating engineered structures and utility structures.
Backlog, order growth, and margin disclosures for utility structures.
Management commentary on transmission, distribution, substations, grid hardening, and renewables interconnection.
Capacity additions, plant conversions, or manufacturing-line changes supporting utility-pole output.
Customer mix across utilities, EPCs, municipalities, and industrial buyers.
Comparison with Valmont, Sabre, and other utility-structure competitors.
falsification: Utility structures are too small relative to total company revenue to matter.
Backlog growth is driven by non-grid infrastructure rather than transmission/distribution demand.
Margins do not improve despite demand, implying limited bottleneck power.
Capacity is easy to add or competitors respond quickly, reducing scarcity.
Broader construction-cycle weakness overwhelms utility-structure growth.
briefs.hidden_signal_to_verify: Utility-structures backlog, lead times, capacity constraints, pricing power, customer mix, margin by segment, and whether converted manufacturing capacity expands large utility-pole output.
monitoring_items: Engineered structures and utility-structures backlog.
Segment margin and pricing commentary.
Lead times and manufacturing capacity utilization.
Utility capex plans and grid-hardening program awards.
Any plant conversion or capacity expansion targeted at utility poles or substation structures.
briefs.why_underfollowed: The company is commonly bucketed as diversified infrastructure, construction products, or engineered structures. That broad label can obscure a utility-structures business that may be tied to grid modernization and transmission buildout.

briefs.brief_cn: Valmont 的研究价值在于：市场通常把它归为农业灌溉、交通照明、综合基建或钢结构公司，但它可能同时受益于输电、配电、变电站、杆塔、结构件和电网加固投资。真正要验证的不是“电网很热”，而是 Utility / grid-facing 业务是否正在贡献更高的订单、毛利和积压订单质量。如果数据中心、大负荷接入、输电升级和配网硬化带来更多杆塔与结构件需求，Valmont 可能位于电网扩建中一个不如变压器、开关设备、EPC 那么显眼的结构性环节。核心证据缺口是：Utility 收入拆分、输电/配电/变电站暴露、积压订单持续时间、钢材与镀锌产能约束、价格传导能力，以及这些因素是否真的转化为增量利润。
briefs.brief_en: Valmont is the main underfollowed name in this chunk. The potential misread is that the market often frames it as a diversified infrastructure, irrigation, lighting, transportation, or steel-structures company, while part of the business may be tied to utility structures used in transmission, distribution, grid-hardening, and substation buildouts. The thesis is not simply that grid capex is rising; it is that Valmont may sit in a less-discussed structural layer where steel structures, galvanizing capacity, utility qualification, and delivery timing matter before construction crews arrive. The key evidence path is to prove whether utility-facing revenue, backlog, pricing, and margins are improving because of grid demand rather than general infrastructure cyclicality.
briefs.chokepoint_thesis: Valmont may be a mid-cap grid-structure chokepoint candidate if utility poles, transmission structures, substation structures, galvanizing capacity, and engineered-steel delivery windows become binding inputs for transmission, distribution, data-center interconnection, and grid-hardening projects.
evidence_to_verify: Company 10-K / 10-Q segment disclosures: isolate utility-facing revenue inside infrastructure or engineered-support structures.
Earnings-call transcripts: search for transmission, distribution, substation, grid hardening, data centers, utility demand, galvanizing, steel cost, and pricing commentary.
Backlog disclosures: determine whether backlog is growing faster in utility structures than in irrigation, transportation, or lighting.
Margin bridge: check whether improved margins come from utility mix and pricing rather than temporary steel-cost relief.
Customer / project evidence: identify utility, EPC, or grid-infrastructure customers and whether orders precede public construction awards.
Capacity evidence: verify galvanizing footprint, fabrication capacity, lead times, and whether capacity is constrained.
falsification: Utility-facing revenue is too small or not growing faster than the rest of the company.
Backlog growth is driven mainly by agriculture, lighting, telecom, or generic infrastructure rather than transmission, distribution, or substations.
Margins improve only because of steel input-cost normalization, not because of pricing power or constrained utility capacity.
Transmission / substation exposure is immaterial relative to lower-growth distribution, lighting, or non-utility structures.
Customers can easily switch to multiple qualified structure suppliers with no lead-time or certification friction.
Data-center or large-load interconnection demand does not translate into Valmont order acceleration.
briefs.hidden_signal_to_verify: Utility revenue and margin mix, backlog visibility, pricing power, steel and galvanizing constraints, exposure to transmission versus distribution versus substations, and data-center-driven utility order acceleration.
monitoring_items: Utility Solutions / infrastructure backlog growth and duration.
Management wording on T&D, grid hardening, substation, and data-center-related utility orders.
Steel and zinc / galvanizing cost pass-through.
Segment margin expansion versus volume growth.
Capex for fabrication or galvanizing capacity.
Utility project awards in regions with data-center load growth.
briefs.why_underfollowed: The market may miss the grid angle because Valmont is commonly categorized under diversified infrastructure, agriculture irrigation, lighting, transportation, and engineered structures rather than as a utility-structure supplier. Unlike headline transformer, switchgear, nuclear, or EPC names, its potential bottleneck sits one layer away from the obvious power-demand story: physical structures and coatings needed before utility construction can proceed.

briefs.brief_cn: MYR Group 更适合作为下游验证锚，而不是隐藏硬件瓶颈。它的价值在于帮助判断输电、配电和变电站建设活动是否真的落地。如果 MYR 的 T&D 积压订单、人工利用率、项目启动节奏和材料可得性同步改善，就能反向验证上游结构件、硬件、绝缘、连接件和电网设备供应商的需求。它的风险也很清晰：施工企业更受人工、项目执行、天气、客户排期和利润率波动影响，不一定拥有稀缺产品控制力。
briefs.brief_en: MYR Group is best used as a downstream T&D construction validation anchor rather than as the preferred hidden bottleneck. If T&D backlog, project starts, outage-window availability, labor deployment, and material procurement all improve, that would support the broader grid-buildout thesis and help validate upstream suppliers such as transmission hardware, structures, insulators, connectors, and substation equipment providers. The chokepoint is less about proprietary product scarcity and more about execution capacity, labor, scheduling, and whether utility capex is turning into real construction activity.
briefs.chokepoint_thesis: MYR can validate whether grid capex is moving from planning into construction, but its own chokepoint exposure is mainly labor availability, outage windows, project execution capacity, and procurement timing rather than scarce proprietary hardware.
evidence_to_verify: Backlog composition by Transmission & Distribution versus Commercial & Industrial.
Earnings-call commentary on utility project timing, crew availability, labor cost, storm work, and outage windows.
Gross margin / operating margin trends in T&D to test whether backlog is profitable or margin-dilutive.
Management commentary on material availability for transformers, poles, conductor, substation equipment, and transmission hardware.
Timing comparison between MYR backlog changes and upstream supplier order growth at companies such as Valmont, Hubbell, PLP, Arcosa, or other grid hardware suppliers.
Utility capex plans and awarded projects in MYR operating regions.
falsification: T&D backlog stagnates or declines despite rising grid-demand narratives.
Backlog grows but margins deteriorate because of labor shortages, fixed-price exposure, or material inflation.
Construction starts are delayed by permitting, interconnection queues, outage-window limits, or customer deferrals.
Commercial & Industrial activity, not utility T&D, explains most growth.
Upstream suppliers report weak order intake while MYR backlog appears strong, suggesting MYR is not a useful leading indicator.
Large projects produce execution losses or working-capital strain.
briefs.hidden_signal_to_verify: T&D backlog growth, procurement constraints, labor availability, outage windows, material availability, margin pressure, and whether backlog changes lead or lag supplier revenue.
monitoring_items: T&D backlog growth and book-to-bill.
T&D margin and project execution commentary.
Labor availability, wage inflation, and crew utilization.
Outage-window availability and permitting delays.
Material procurement constraints.
Comparison of MYR backlog timing with upstream grid-equipment supplier revenue.
briefs.why_underfollowed: MYR is not a hidden hardware supplier. It is included as a reference lane because it can reveal downstream construction activity before or alongside revenue recognition by upstream suppliers. The market may still underuse it as a timing indicator for transmission and distribution project conversion.

briefs.brief_cn: Hubbell 是电网设备和 Utility Solutions 的大盘参考标的，而不是本轮的隐藏发现。它覆盖输配电、变电站、电网自动化、计量、通信和其他公用事业产品，因此能作为行业需求强弱和估值锚。但它的问题是暴露不够纯：买 Hubbell 不是只买输电硬件或某个狭窄卡点，而是买一个更分散、更受关注的电气设备组合。需要拆清 Utility Solutions 中到底多少来自输电硬件和变电站部件，多少来自 AMI、计量、自动化、通信、燃气分销或控制系统。
briefs.brief_en: Hubbell is a large-cap grid-equipment benchmark rather than an underfollowed discovery. It is useful because its Utility Solutions segment overlaps with transmission, distribution, substation components, metering, automation, telecom, gas distribution, and grid controls. That breadth makes it a strong reference point for grid demand, but it also weakens purity. The research task is to disaggregate how much of the Utility Solutions growth is tied to hard transmission and substation bottlenecks versus broader grid automation, meters, software, telecom, or gas-distribution hardware.
briefs.chokepoint_thesis: Hubbell may benefit from broad utility-grid modernization, but the chokepoint claim only holds if transmission hardware, substation components, connectors, insulators, and other hard grid products are driving growth rather than less-scarce or more diversified utility categories.
evidence_to_verify: Utility Solutions product-level disclosures and investor presentations.
Revenue growth by Utility Solutions subcategory, especially transmission, distribution, substation, connectors, arresters, insulators, and grid hardware.
Earnings-call commentary separating hard electrical products from meters, AMI, automation, telecom, gas, and software.
Backlog or order commentary for utility hardware categories.
Margins by segment and whether mix is improving from constrained products.
Competitive overlap with private suppliers and smaller public transmission-hardware names.
falsification: Utility Solutions growth is mainly from meters, AMI, software, automation, telecom, or gas distribution rather than scarce transmission / substation hardware.
Transmission-hardware exposure is too small to affect consolidated results.
Large-cap valuation already reflects grid growth, leaving little evidence of mispricing.
Margins normalize as supply constraints ease or competitors add capacity.
Utilities defer grid-hardware purchases because of permitting, rate-case pressure, or capex reprioritization.
Smaller suppliers show stronger order acceleration while Hubbell’s relevant categories lag.
briefs.hidden_signal_to_verify: How much Utility Solutions revenue is specifically tied to transmission hardware and substation components versus meters, AMI, automation, telecom, gas distribution, and grid controls.
monitoring_items: Utility Solutions organic growth.
Subcategory commentary on transmission, substation, connectors, insulators, and grid hardware.
Segment margin and price-cost spread.
Order growth versus revenue growth.
Utility capex commentary from management.
Relative performance versus smaller grid-hardware and structure suppliers.
briefs.why_underfollowed: Not underfollowed. It is included as a benchmark because its Utility Solutions segment overlaps with the same transmission, distribution, and substation markets that smaller or purer candidates may serve.

briefs.brief_cn: BWXT 是核能与先进核燃料链条的参考龙头，而不是隐藏小票。它可能涉及先进燃料制造、TRISO、HALEU 邻近项目、核部件和商业核服务，但公司整体还包含大量海军核业务，因此需要把先进核燃料和商业核项目从国防/海军核业务中拆出来。核心问题是：市场是否已经把核能复兴、先进反应堆和燃料瓶颈充分计入估值；以及先进燃料相关收入、积压订单和产能是否足够大，能影响公司整体增长。
briefs.brief_en: BWX Technologies is a reference leader for nuclear services, nuclear components, and potentially advanced-fuel-related programs. It is not an underfollowed small-cap discovery. The key issue is exposure purity: naval nuclear, commercial nuclear services, components, advanced fuel fabrication, TRISO, and HALEU-adjacent work need to be separated. The chokepoint claim is strongest only if advanced fuel fabrication or scarce nuclear manufacturing capacity becomes a meaningful revenue and backlog driver rather than a small optionality layer inside a larger naval nuclear business.
briefs.chokepoint_thesis: BWXT may sit near scarce nuclear manufacturing and advanced-fuel capabilities, but the investable chokepoint thesis depends on proving that advanced fuel, TRISO, HALEU-adjacent work, or commercial nuclear capacity are material and accelerating, not merely a narrative add-on to the larger naval nuclear franchise.
evidence_to_verify: Program-level disclosures separating naval nuclear, commercial nuclear, medical isotopes, advanced reactors, advanced fuel, TRISO, and HALEU-adjacent work.
Backlog and funded-order commentary tied specifically to advanced fuel or commercial nuclear programs.
Government contracts, DOE awards, NRC-related filings, and customer announcements for advanced nuclear fuel or reactor programs.
Capacity expansion timelines for fuel fabrication, nuclear components, or specialized manufacturing.
Customer concentration and dependence on government funding cycles.
Margin profile of advanced nuclear work versus core naval nuclear business.
falsification: Advanced fuel / TRISO / HALEU-adjacent revenue remains immaterial relative to naval nuclear revenue.
Backlog growth is primarily naval or defense-driven, not commercial advanced nuclear.
DOE, reactor developer, or utility programs are delayed, canceled, or fail to reach funding milestones.
Capacity additions take longer or cost more than expected.
Fuel-cycle bottlenecks are captured by uranium conversion, enrichment, or HALEU suppliers rather than BWXT fabrication.
Customer concentration or government-budget timing dominates the growth outlook.
briefs.hidden_signal_to_verify: Revenue and backlog tied specifically to advanced fuel fabrication, TRISO, HALEU-adjacent programs, naval nuclear versus commercial nuclear split, customer concentration, and capacity timing.
monitoring_items: Backlog by program and customer type.
Advanced fuel, TRISO, HALEU-adjacent, and commercial nuclear contract awards.
DOE and defense-budget funding milestones.
Capacity expansion and qualification timelines.
Revenue split between naval nuclear and commercial nuclear.
Evidence that advanced nuclear work is large enough to affect consolidated growth.
briefs.why_underfollowed: Not underfollowed. It is included as a reference leader because public-market exposure to advanced nuclear fuel fabrication and nuclear manufacturing capacity is scarce, but BWXT itself is larger, better followed, and has mixed exposure.

summary: Split Layer 4 briefs merged from ranked-candidate chunks.
